summary: Frontend-only verification of two new features on BIOTECH LIFESCIENCES: (1) three prominent navbar CTAs (SHOP, STACK BUILDER, ABOUT US) next to logo, and (2) deterministic per-product Reviews widget. All acceptance criteria pass. No console errors on any tested route. Mobile collapse and regression flows (age gate, cart, wishlist, /guide, /cart, /checkout, stack builder) all working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 verified new navbar CTAs (nav-cta-shop, nav-cta-stack-builder, nav-cta-about-us) route correctly to /products, /stacks, /about. Secondary text links (nav-peptide-guide, nav-contact) present. ProductReviews widget renders between uses-section and technical record on /products/:slug — reviews-summary shows avg rating + '<n> verified researcher reviews', 3 review-card-<i> with review-verified-<i> badges. Reviews deterministic on reload and slug-specific (retatrutide differs from bpc-157). Mobile 390x844: CTA group hidden, mobile-menu opens with all 11 expected entries. No console errors. Cart add-to-cart increments cart-count to 1. /guide, /cart, /checkout render. No regressions.
